verdict.rationale: The API exposes much of what Perplexity's user-facing products do. Web-grounded answers with citations, raw search, multi-step Pro Search, a code sandbox, multi-turn context and structured output are all documented. The Computer agent's capabilities (browsing, code execution, document and media creation) can be called from an MCP client, and the search Playground mirrors the Search API. However, no evidence states UI–API parity, and console/account functions (key management, billing, profile management) are not shown to be API-accessible. missing for 10: explicit parity statement or mapping of UI features to API endpoints, API coverage of console/admin functions, independent hands-on corroboration of parity

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Computer can: Search and browse the web for real-time information, including login-gated pages ... Write and execute code in an interactive Linux sandbox ... Create documents and media including PDFs, slide decks, spreadsheets, images, and videos
your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.
You can also [try Perplexity Search in the interactive Playground](https://console.perplexity.ai/project/playground/search) with no API key required.
Get accurate, up-to-date answers grounded in real-time web search, with inline citations in a single call, and conversation context across turns.
When enabled, the model can perform multiple web searches and fetch URL content to answer complex queries.
